# Strands Agent Template

[![Awesome Strands Agents](https://img.shields.io/badge/Awesome-Strands%20Agents-00FF77?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/cagataycali/awesome-strands-agents)

A minimal Python [Strands](https://strandsagents.com) agent deployed to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime with TypeScript CDK.

The demo uses Bedrock with calculator, current-time, and letter-counter tools. It includes an ARM64 container, an IAM role, and GitHub Actions checks. Deployments are manual.

## Quick Start

Click **Use this template** on GitHub, then clone your repository.

Local runs need Python 3.14, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) 0.12, and AWS credentials with Bedrock model access. Deployment also needs Node.js 24, Docker, and AWS CLI v2; see [prerequisites](DEPLOYMENT.md#prerequisites).

From the repository root:

```bash
export AWS_REGION=us-west-2
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
cd agent
uv sync --locked
uv run python src/agentcore_app.py
```

In another terminal:

```bash
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/invocations \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"Use calculator to calculate 42 * 137."}'
```

Expect `status: "success"` and a response containing 5,754. Wording varies.

## Deploy and Customize

Follow [DEPLOYMENT.md](DEPLOYMENT.md) to deploy, invoke the runtime, and clean up. After the smoke test, edit `agent/src/agentcore_app.py` and add or replace tools in `agent/src/tools/`.

- [Agent guide](agent/README.md): configuration and custom tools
- [CDK guide](cdk/README.md): infrastructure and development commands
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): checks and contribution workflow
- [Background blog post](https://danielleheberling.xyz/blog/strands-agent-template/): design decisions
